messages:
rachel: Acme wants a single onboarding doc for AWS/GCP/Azure. propose private trial first, then public. quick sync on artifacts we need?

tom: short checklist per cloud: Azure private = offerAlias + manifest + webhook; GCP private = manifest + allowed_customer_ids + region flag; AWS SaaS = listing JSON + entitlement mapping + metering webhook.

priya: product: trial 30 days, token cap 50k across clouds, no auto-charge. manual conversion only. SI (DeltaSys) will need SAML metadata and a joint runbook.

legal-bot: legal checklist: trial duration in plain language, privacy note (usage metadata only, no raw prompts), termination & refund clause, export control statement. will drop a 1-paragraph template.

ops-bot: ops notes: provide sample manifest to partner. must implement webhook with X-Marketplace-Signature validation and replay protection. stash manifests in cloud buckets: s3://redwood-marketplace/, gs://redwood-marketplace/, and s3://redwood-marketplace/azure/.

rachel: can someone paste a tiny manifest snippet we can share?

tom: sample manifest (sanitized):
```json
{"offerAlias":"acme-redwood-trial","plans":[{"id":"trial30","displayName":"30 Day Trial","limits":{"tokens_per_month":50000}}],"support":"partners@redwood.ai","manifestVersion":"1.0"}
```

priya: SI runbook items: SAML metadata URL, support oncall contact, test accounts, and terraform snippet for role creation. we'll hand to DeltaSys tomorrow.

legal-bot: draft blurb: "Try Redwood Inference free for 30 days (up to 50k tokens/month). By enrolling you accept Redwood's Marketplace Terms and Privacy Policy. We collect usage metadata for billing and analytics; we do not store raw customer content."

rachel: action items: tom=upload manifests to buckets and create offer aliases; priya=assemble SI runbook + terraform snippet; legal-bot=finalize paragraph and EULA delta. partner handoff scheduled 9:30am PT tomorrow.

ops-bot: once OfferIDs returned, post them here and run webhook test.

rachel: thanks, will post one-pager after handoff. :white_check_mark:
